items.message: No action needed: issue #633 is a thank-you note with no bug, feature request, or question. It does not match any triage kind (not a test, promotion, spam, or wrong-project report), so it gets no label and no comment. The reporter's author_association is NONE, so the maintainer-authored shortcut did not apply; the completeness, FAQ, duplicate and named-API checks found nothing actionable (closest duplicate candidates were thank-you or usage threads, not the same problem).
